boundaries: Knowledge Librarian preflight and explicit operator/work-package authority come before READY.
Mission Planner structures an already authorized work package; it does not authorize a programme.
Resource Manager does not reserve or kill processes.
Qualification Manager delegates execution to the existing eiel_campaign/eiel_qualification tools.
Evidence Manager uses the existing Evidence Decision Layer and requires the governing mission authority context.
Codex executes externally through existing approved EIEL campaign tooling.
purpose: Authority-bound deterministic local workflow for Codex. The managers retain receipts and never create strategy, execution authority, qualification authority, or scientific truth.

steps.question: What already-authorized work am I structuring?

steps.command: python -m tools.eiel missionPlanner preflight MIS-... --topic '<exact topic>' --authorization-basis operator_instruction --operator-instruction-ref '<operator instruction>' --ready
steps.question: What authority, evidence, limitations, and unknown gaps govern this mission?
Can I trust the requested route?

steps.command: python -m tools.eiel missionPlanner update MIS-... --qualification-ref QCHK-...
python -m tools.eiel missionPlanner update MIS-... --resource-ref RADM-... --status ACTIVE
python -m tools.scripts.eiel_campaign preflight CAMPAIGN_SPEC.json && python -m tools.scripts.eiel_campaign run CAMPAIGN_SPEC.json
steps.question: Run with existing approved EIEL campaign tooling

steps.command: python -m tools.eiel missionPlanner update MIS-... --campaign-spec-ref CAMPAIGN_SPEC.json --campaign-output-ref PATH --report-ref REPORT.md --source-commit COMMIT
python -m tools.eiel evidenceManager assess MANIFEST.json --mission MIS-... --deterministic
steps.question: What do outputs procedurally support?

steps.command: python -m tools.eiel missionPlanner update MIS-... --evidence-ref EDM-... --status EVIDENCE_PENDING
python -m tools.eiel missionPlanner closeout MIS-... --closeout CLOSEOUT.json --librarian-document-id EIEL-DOC-... --strict-references
